title: The exact hierarchical cavity pressure for dilute even-arity spin glasses
exact_target: For the even-arity dilute Ising models satisfying the Panchenko–Talagrand factorization, integrability and positivity hypotheses, does the thermodynamic mean pressure equal the infimum of the explicit finite-hierarchy cavity trial functional over every finite hierarchy depth and trial law, with convergence also in probability?
